title: クレーンゲーム大成功！

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Stunning! That was some world-class skill!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I never imagined I'd be able to witness such an incredible performance up close!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm not! You've just gone and filled me with hopes and dreams!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You can gain special skills as long as you work hard! Nothing's impossible in this world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Thank you for confirming my convictions!
